audits.secondSweep: A dedicated P5/P6 sweep re-read every sentence for inanimate or abstract subjects carrying agency, desire, cognition, combustion or physical-behaviour verbs. It also covered body-part subjects, abstract states settling into the body, actors demoted into instrument phrases, and metaphor chains across consecutive sentences. Geography verbs (L231 lane 'ran', L606 grooves 'running', L632 cut 'ran/went on/went over', L800 road 'climbed' and country 'opened', L844 road 'came round') are standard path idiom with no intention, in the guide's 'the road led' class. Light and reflection verbs (L185 lantern 'turning the air into a slow gold fog', L233 water 'holding the lantern', L277 lantern 'smearing gold') name the real physical cause. Every body-part subject is involuntary, which is the Pattern 8 exception: L191 arm flinched, L219 and L398 injured fingers, L237 eyes 'a beat behind the light' from fatigue, L353 and L596 the hand drifting to the string, L490 fist clenching, L530 and L724 shoulders, L558 and L794 the girl's head, L742 the carter's mouth going slack, L812 the mage nodding off. A few are POV-limited synecdoche where Sylvanas cannot yet see the person: L372 'The hands down there', L378 and L382 'a face'. Abstract or internal subjects (L279 'Everything in her wanted', L544 the noon stone 'pointed north, because she wanted it to', L778 'It had caught on her') are condition-2 POV states with no command, judgment or deception, and L544 hands the agency back to Sylvanas inside the same sentence. 'The chamber' (L702, L830) is a collective actor whose members are named in the same passage (Lor'themar, the magister's nephew). No permission tags remain: L414 'Neral let her keep it' is physical allowing with an object, and L544 'if she let herself' is outside the closed tag set.
